ros.expect: Sleeper's week-w projection alone beats season PPG at every week; the best blend puts most weight on the projection and xFP; the 50/50 prior+PPG rule is 5-10% worse in MAE than the best blend.
ros.curve_note: prior/ROS rank -> PPG of the k-th best player at the position in the PREVIOUS season (>= 8 games)

spread.expect: Coverage: the IQR-based table gives about 50% at the 50% interval but well under 90% at the 90% interval (heavy right tail). Player trait: split-half correlation of the residual-SD ratio 0.1-0.3, season to season under 0.2; the NLL-best shrinkage is 20+ games, so SD_SHRINK = 6 is too light.

trait.units: player-seasons with mean projection >= 5; residual RMS in table units

dst.expect: About -0.2 to -0.3 D/ST points per point of opponent implied total; quality adds little; the 24/19 rule gains about 1.5-2 points per move but fires rarely; a gap rule (ours minus FA >= 4-5) does as well per move and fires more often.

k.expect: About +0.15 to +0.25 K points per point of own implied total; dome +0.3-0.5; wind above 15 mph costs about 1 point; a 4-point gap is worth about 0.6-1.0 points per move, close to the noise floor.

flags.expect: BUY players outscore points-rank peers by about +1 PPG over the next four weeks (CI touching 0 to +2); SELL players underperform by about -1; the effect grows with the gap and the gap of 8 is in the flat part.
flags.outcome: PPG over weeks w to w+3, players with 2+ games in that window

gate_r74.expect: A ros_rate gap keeps its sign about 60% of the time at 1 point a game and 80% near 3-4 points; realized gaps are about half the predicted ones; at a cost of 0 the best gate is under 1 point, so 2.5 trades gain for certainty.
gate_r74.realized: PPG over games played in weeks w-17 (both players 2+ games); points_per_team_game counts a missed game as 0

backup_r77.expect: Starting QBs miss about 8% of their remaining games and starting TEs about 10%; from week 6 that is about 0.7-0.9 regular-season games, and with the playoff weights the allowance is about 2-3 units, so 1 is too low.

role_r75_r90.expect: About half of a one-week snap-share jump persists into the next three games (slope about 0.5) and about two thirds of a two-week one; the one-week flag carries signal, so 'one week is noise' is wrong, but the two-week read is the stronger one.
role_r75_r90.outcome: mean over the next 3 games played

ownratio_r89.expect: Blending the 3-week own ratio helps little: for volume-confirmed over-performers the next-week MAE falls by 0.1-0.3 at a weight of 0.25-0.5 and rises at 1.0; for TD-driven streaks it does not help.

alarms_r88.expect: Per week, 50% coverage on 16 lines falls outside 0.35-0.65 about 21% of the time, so 'three weeks' fires often by chance unless the weeks must be consecutive and in one direction; a middle slice over 30% fires very often early in the season.
alarms_r88.assumption: calibrated forecaster, independent lines (binomial), 16 settled weeks a season
